stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Harvey Nichols bought by Sports Direct owner. Harvey Nichols was founded in 1831, but had appointed an administrator in June. Source: BBC Business.
article_sentences: Department store Harvey Nichols has been bought by the owners of Sports Direct.
Mike Ashley's Frasers Group will take control of the six Harvey Nichols stores including its flagship in Knightsbridge and the international franchise.
It will also acquire the online business, and stores will continue to operate under their existing licensing.
Harvey Nichols, founded in 1831, had appointed an administrator in June.
